test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

The Covid-19 pandemic has hit many industries really _______.
solution:
The correct answer is Hard.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The adverb **'hard' **means a great deal of effort.

 
 
• *** Example:*** The speaker tried ***hard*** to impress the audience.
 
 
 
• The adverb **'hard'** should be used in the context of the sentence.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ***An adverb is a word or phrase that modifies or qualifies an adjective, verb, or other adverb or a word group.***
 
• Now let's understand the difference between the adverbs given below:
 
• ​**Hard**- With a great amount of effort.
 
• **Hardly**- scarcely (used to qualify a statement by saying that it is true to an insignificant degree).
 
 
• ***Example: ***He hardly does any work.​
